prompt: csvjoin is a single-file command line tool with a five-line README. Set up documentation for it under docs/guide in our standard layout and write it. Only add the optional books if they make sense for this project. The source repository is https://github.com/example/csvjoin.
assertions: A user book and an operator book exist
There is no tester book (the repository has no tests and no CI)
The report says the tester book was left out and why
Operator book documents every flag (--on, --how, --delimiter, --encoding, --output) and CSVJOIN_MAX_ROWS with its default 1000000
No page invents a test command (pytest, make test, unittest)
No page uses GitBook-only blocks ({% hint %}, {% tabs %}, ...)
